Question 2

Consider the circle of radius 5 centered at the origin, as shown above. Which of the following sets of parametric equations, defined for θ∈[0,2π), traverse the circle once in the counterclockwise direction starting at the point A(5,0)?

a
x=25cos⁡θ,y=10sin⁡θ
b
x=5cos⁡θ,y=5sin⁡θ
c
x=5cos⁡θ,y=5sin⁡θ
d
x=25cos⁡θ,y=25sin⁡θ
e
x=10cos⁡θ,y=10sin⁡θ
